school: 十八世纪末'以测量立信'的意大利实验物理学宗师：把沙龙奇观重做成可测量的量，以自己的舌身为最灵敏的仪表，以示零比较取代直接读数，把'电'切分成张力与量两个正交量纲，再以平庸单元的六十层串联催生出人类第一枚持续电源——他是证明'怀疑是一种工作量、复制是一种发明'的人
historical_significance: 伏特（Alessandro Volta，1745-1827），生于科莫，长于科莫与帕维亚：1774 年任科莫皇家学校物理教师，1775 年发明并公开起电盘（electrophorus，把 Wilcke 1762 年的先例重做成'人人可造、感应起电不竭'的普及器件），1776-1777 年在科莫湖沼发现并收集可燃空气（甲烷），发明以电火花点火的电点火手枪；1779 年任帕维亚大学实验物理学讲席，此后四十年；他区分'张力'（tension，电势）与'量'（quantity，电荷），以电容天平与可变电容器完成张力测量，发现电容定律；1791 年入选皇家学会，1794 年获科普利奖章；1791 年伽伐尼发表蛙腿'动物电'后，伏特以九年'最不轻信'的复现工作走向接触电理论，1800 年 3 月 20 日致皇家学会会长 Banks 的信中宣布电堆（pile）与杯冠（couronne de tasses）——人类第一枚持续电流源，直接开启电化学与电磁学的时代；1801 年应拿破仑之邀在巴黎三次演示，次年获金质奖章，1809 年任意大利王国参议员，1810 年受封伯爵；他晚年退居科莫附近 Camnago，1827 年在此逝世；电压单位'伏特'（volt）以他命名——他证明：一个人可以用二十五年沉默耕耘充一枚惊雷，并以'人人可复制'的器件让发现成为公共财产
historical_significance_en: Alessandro Volta (1745-1827), born at Como, formed at Como and Pavia: physics master at the Como Royal School in 1774, in 1775 he invented and published the electrophorus — remaking Wilcke's obscure 1762 precedent into a build-it-yourself device whose induced charge never ran dry; in 1776-77 he discovered and collected the inflammable air of the Como marshes (methane) and built the electric pistol that ignites it by spark; from 1779 to the end he held the chair of experimental physics at Pavia, forty years; he separated tension (potential) from quantity (charge), measured tension with the condensing electroscope and the variable capacitor, and found the law of capacitance; elected to the Royal Society in 1791, awarded the Copley Medal in 1794; after Galvani's 'animal electricity' of 1791 he worked nine years of 'least credulity' toward the contact theory, and on 20 March 1800 announced in his letter to Sir Joseph Banks the pile and the couronne de tasses — humanity's first source of continuous current, opening at a stroke the age of electrochemistry and electromagnetism; summoned by Napoleon, he demonstrated three times in Paris in 1801, took the gold medal the next year, sat as senator of the Italian kingdom from 1809, and was made count in 1810; he retired to Camnago near Como, and died there in 1827; the unit of potential, the volt, bears his name — he proved that a man may charge a thunderclap with twenty-five years of silent work, and make his discovery public property by giving it away in copyable form
unique_thinking: 伏特的独特处在于：他把'信与不信'变成了一件可以计量的工作——不轻信意味着重做一切，示零意味着让自然自己开口；他先切分量纲再动手测量（张力/量），先校准身体再动用仪器（舌尝双金属），最后以最平庸的单元做出最惊人的堆叠（铜|湿布|锌六十层）；他不与伽伐尼争辩胜负，而是把九年的论战改写为自己的实验目录，在对方没布防的缝隙里立起整个接触电理论；他最深的原则是公共性——起电盘附说明书、电堆全公开，把私人发现铸成所有持有者的共同经验；而荣誉之下他始终留着那间只有自己能关门的小实验室
unique_thinking_en: Volta's singularity: he turned believing and doubting into work that can be metered — least credulity meant redoing everything, the null method meant letting nature speak for itself; he split the dimensions before measuring (tension against quantity), calibrated the body before invoking the instrument (the metals on his tongue), and built the most astonishing stack from the most mediocre unit (sixty layers of copper, wet cloth, zinc); he never fought Galvani for victory, but rewrote nine years of controversy as his own docket of experiments, raising the whole contact theory in the gap the other side never garrisoned; his deepest principle was publicness — the electrophorus with its manual, the pile fully published, private discovery cast into the common experience of every holder; and beneath the honors he always kept the little laboratory whose door only he could close
civilization_zh: 十八世纪末的欧洲电学——一只'最不轻信'的手把公共演示的奇观重做成可测量的量，在伽伐尼之争的喧嚣里以自己的身体当仪器，用 forty 年讲席把一门在沙龙里表演的学问压成有单位的科学
civilization_en: Late eighteenth-century European electricity — one of the least credulous hands in Europe remade the parlor marvel into the measurable quantity, used his own body as an instrument amid the Galvani uproar, and pressed a science performed in salons into a science with units across forty years at the lectern

cross_references.description_zh: 伏特与本杰明·富兰克林是十八世纪电学的双子星，同为'公共科学'的化身：富兰克林以风筝实验证明闪电即电、以避雷针把发现变成公共安全，伏特以起电盘与电堆把发现变成公共器件——两人都坚信科学应属于所有持有者；差异在于富兰克林是'业余的政治家科学家'（电学是他的副业），伏特是'职业的学院科学家'（四十年讲席）——平行命题：一门学科可以在沙龙与议会两处同时扎根。
cross_references.description_en: Volta and Benjamin Franklin are the twin stars of eighteenth-century electricity, both embodiments of 'public science': Franklin proved lightning electrical with his kite and turned the discovery into public safety with the lightning rod, Volta turned discovery into public instrument with the electrophorus and the pile — both held that science belongs to its holders; the difference is that Franklin was the amateur statesman-scientist (electricity his side work), Volta the professional academic (forty years at the chair); the parallel thesis: a discipline may root at once in the salon and in the assembly.

cross_references.description_zh: 伏特与瓦特是同一时代的两台'发动机'：瓦特以分离冷凝器把热机从耗煤怪物改成工业心脏，伏特以电堆把电从一瞬的火花改成持续的流——两人都以'分离'取胜（分离冷凝/分离张力与量）、都以可复制的器件改变一门技术、都靠专利或公开的不同策略经营发现（瓦特靠专利延伸与按节约计价，伏特靠完全公开与声望变现）——平行命题：工业革命的两个源头，一个来自火的持续，一个来自电的持续。
cross_references.description_en: Volta and Watt are the two engines of one age: Watt remade the heat engine from a coal-devouring monster into the industrial heart with the separate condenser, Volta remade electricity from a momentary spark into a continuous flow with the pile — both won by separation (separate condenser; tension split from quantity), both changed a technology with copyable devices, both ran their discoveries by opposite strategies (Watt by patent extension and metered savings, Volta by full publication and monetized renown); the parallel thesis: the two headwaters of the industrial revolution — one from the continuity of fire, one from the continuity of electricity.

cross_references.description_zh: 伏特与高斯同以'精确'立身而方法相反：伏特是实验家，他的精确来自让自然开口的示零比较与亲手复现，成果是一台机器（电堆）；高斯是理论家，他的精确来自先于观测的纯数学推演（谷神星轨道、正十七边形），成果是一套方法——伏特先做再想，高斯先想再做；对照命题：精确有两条路——一条由手通向概念，一条由概念通向手。另注：高斯与韦伯 1833 年建成世界首台电磁电报，正是伏特电堆开启的电磁学时代的直接果实。
cross_references.description_en: Volta and Gauss both stood on precision and by opposite roads: Volta the experimentalist, whose precision came from null comparison that lets nature speak and from redoing by hand, his fruit a machine (the pile); Gauss the theorist, whose precision came from pure mathematics before observation (the orbit of Ceres, the 17-gon), his fruit a method — Volta did and then thought, Gauss thought and then did; the contrast thesis: precision has two roads — one from the hand to the concept, one from the concept to the hand. Note: Gauss and Weber's first electromagnetic telegraph of 1833 is the direct fruit of the electromagnetic age the pile opened.
